verses.1: Woe to you, O man, and to those like you who do not believe in God who created you, and do not believe His commandment and His word. Since you are alive, repent toward that which does not accept repentance when you are punished in the fire of Sheol.
verses.2: And you have no escape from it forever—you and your gods, and those who worship and bow down to them as to God your Maker—those who have no breath or spirit, and who cannot heal the one who is sick among them, nor raise up the one who is cast down.
verses.3: For the work of men's hands is what Satan speaks within them, to deceive the heart of those like you, O servants, so that he may bring you down into the fire of Gehenna—for you and for your graven gods and for the demons who rule over you.
verses.4: For you do not believe that there is one who will judge you; you err and go astray.
verses.5: Yet the beasts which God created for your service are better than you, and also the wild animals and the dogs; for they have no understanding except for one death alone.
verses.6: But you shall die and be punished again in the fire of Gehenna, which has no escape forever.
verses.7: And when he had said this to them, they departed and hid themselves from him.
verses.8: But Zerubbabel was seized with great fear and trembling, and he did not leave him until morning.
verses.9: And after this he went to where the righteous had left their corpses, and he did not find them, for He had willed to take them up and remove them, because God had hidden them so that no one might seek after their flesh.
